chapter.verse: Vanglianpen Topa in hih bangin ci hi: “Siampite aw, note’ adingin hih lai-ah thupiakna khat om hi.

Na gamtatna uh tawh kei nong zahtak ding uh hi. Ka thugente ngai loin, thupi takin na lak kei uh leh note tungah samsiatna ka hong tungsak ding a, siampi hihna tawh na ngah uh thuphate tungah samsiatna ka tungsak ding hi. A taktakin ci lehang, note in ka thupiaknate thupilak lo na hih manun na thupha ngahte uh tungah samsiatna ka tungsak zo hi.
Na suan-le-khakte uh nakpi takin ka thuhilh ding a, note ahih leh, na biak piakna ganhing uh a ekte tawh na maitang uh hong zut gawpin tuate tawh kong lawnkhia khawm ding hi.
Tua ciangin, Levi’ suan-le-khakte ahi siampite tawh ka thuciamna a kip nawn lo ahihna thu, hih thu kong genna-ah na thei ding uh hi.
Amaute a nuntak nading leh a nopsak nading thu ka ciam a, amaute in kei hong zahtak theih nadingun hih ka thuciamte khempeuh ka pia hi. Amaute in kei hong zahtakin hong kihta takpi uh hi:
Amaute in thuman taktakte mah hilhin gen uh a, amaute’ kam panin zuauna thu ging khia lo hi. Ka deihna bangin amaute gamta uh a, a khial ding mi tampite, thuman lamah paisak uh hi.
Siampite’ nasep in Pasian a man-a theih nading a hilh ding uh ahi hi. Amaute pen Vanglianpen Topa ’ kamtaite ahih manin, mite in keima deihna a theih nadingun amaute tungah thu a dot ding uh ahi hi.
Ahi zongin, no, siampite na hih uh leh lampi man panin na pial khin uh hi. Na thuhilhnate un mi tampi tak khialsak hi. Note tawh ka bawl thuciamna na palsat khin uh hi.

Tua ahih manin, note in ka thuhilhna zui loin, keima thu na hilh uh ciangin zong a kibangin hilh loin mi na deidan mah bangun, kei zong, mi khempeuh mai-ah simmawhna leh niamkhiatna kong ngahsak hi,” a ci hi.

Eite khempeuh in, eite a hong piangsak Pasian ahi pa khat bek nei hilo i hi hiam? Tua hi napi-in bang hangin eite khat leh khat tungah citak loin, i pu i pate tawh a bawl, Pasian’ thuciamna palsat i hi hiam?

Judah mite citak loin, Pasian’ tungah a thuciamna uh palsat uh a, Israel mite’ lak leh Jerusalem khua sungah siatna tampi gamta uh hi. Topa in a it mahmah biakinn ninsak uh hi. Topa ahi lo, pasian dang a bia numeite zi-in la-in ten’pih uh hi.
Hih banga a gamta mi peuhmah, a kua a kua hita leh, Topa in sugawp hen la, Vanglianpen Topa ’ tungah biakna a paipih ei minamte tawh hong kigawmsak ngei nawn kei hen.
Note’ gamtatna adang khat om lai hi. Tua in, note in Topa ’ biakna tau, khitui tawh na kawtsak uh a, kapin thuumin na om uh hangin note’ paipih biaknate, amah in hong sang nawn lo hi.

Bang hangin hong sang lo hiam, na ci uh hi. Na khangno lai uh a, na ten’pih na zite uh tungah na cihtak lohna uh amah in hong thei a, na zite uh tungah na cihtak tawntung nading uh Pasian tungah thuciamin, na zite uh zong na lawmnu mah uh hi napi-in amaute tawh na thuciamna uh na pelhna hang uh ahi hi.

Pasian in na zite uh tawh pum khat, lungsim khat ahi dingin hong bawl hilo ahi hiam? Hih banga hong bawlna in bang a deihna ahi hiam? Pasian’ mi taktak ahi ding tate i neih theih nading ahi hi. Tua ahih manin na khangno lai-un na ten’pih na zi uh tawh na thuciamna uh na palsat khak loh nadingun kidawm un.

Vanglianpen Topa in hih bangin ci hi: “Zi makna ka deih kei a, mi khatpeuh in a khangno lai-a a teen’pih a zi tungah tua bang gitlohna a gamtatna ka mudah hi. Tua ahih ciangin hoih takin kidawm un la, a citak dingin na zite uh tungah na thuciamna uh palsat kei un,” ci hi, a ci hi.

Na thugen genna uh tawh Topa na gimsak uh hi. Note in, “Bangci gimsak ka hi uh hiam?” na ci uh hi. “ Topa in a sia-a gamtate a hoihin ngaihsun a, zong itin amaute tungah lungkim takpi hi,” na cihna khawng uh leh, “A thutang gen Pasian koi lai-ah om ahi hiam?” ci-in na dotnate uh tawh na gimsak uh hi.
